verses.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ੧੩ : ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਦੀ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ
verses.translit_en: pauRee 13 : prem ras dhee ik nimakh

en.bdb: One moment of the joy of love

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖ ਫਲੁ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਅਲਖੁ ਅਲੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh sukh fal piram ras til alakh alekhai|

en.bdb: Even a fraction of pleasure fruit of gurmukhs in the form of joy of love is imperceptible and beyond all accounts.

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਜੂਨਿ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਸੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh chauraaseeh joon vich jeea ja(n)t visekhai|

en.bdb: Many are the creatures in the eighty-four lacs of species.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਭਨਾ ਦੀ ਰੋਮਾਵਲੀ ਬਹੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: sabhanaa dhee romaavalee bahu bidh bahu bhekhai|

en.bdb: They all have variegated colour of their trichomes.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰੋਮਿ ਰੋਮਿ ਲਖ ਲਖ ਸਿਰ ਮੁਹੁ ਲਖ ਸਰੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: rom rom lakh lakh sir muh lakh sarekhai|

en.bdb: If to their single hair millions of heads and mouths were joined;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਖ ਲਖ ਮੁਹਿ ਮੁਹਿ ਜੀਭੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਦੇਖੈ।
verses.translit_en: lakh lakh muh muh jeebh kar sun bolai dhekhai|

en.bdb: If such million of mouths could speak through their millions of tongues;

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੰਖ ਅਸੰਖ ਇਕੀਹ ਵੀਹ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਨ ਨਿਮੇਖੈ ॥੧੩॥
verses.translit_en: sa(n)kh asa(n)kh ikeeh veeh samasar na nimekhai ||13||

en.bdb: If myriad times more the world were created, even then it cannot equal the one moment (of the delight of love).
